newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Air adds US-Johannesburg service.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Air adds US-Johannesburg service.

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it has inaugurated a new two-day export air cargo service from four US cities to Johannesburg, South Africa.
Called "Jo-Burg Direct", the service promises shippers time definite delivery and improved transit times, the company said in a statement.

"Our new direct service to Johannesburg from North America significantly improves transit times of shipments to South Africa. We feel no other freight forwarder can match our speed or service to this part of Africa," said Malcolm Heath, Burlington's senior vice-president, US International.
Traffic is consolidated at New York, Los Angeles, Chicago and Atlanta, and then shipped directly from those cities, the company said.

Shipments leave from New York on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, from Los Angeles on Wednesday and Saturday, from Chicago on Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, and from Atlanta on Wednesday and Saturday. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
